metaTitle: Custom Gray On Ear Headphones | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gray on ear headphones for your team or event. Bulk pricing and free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray on ear headphones offer a professional, understated look that blends into any office or event setting without clashing with branded apparel or decor. Whether you need a quiet, comfortable headset for your call center or a simple giveaway for a trade show, the neutral gray finish pairs well with any logo color. Choose foam or leatherette ear cushions and add your imprint via pad print or direct laser engraving for a clean, lasting mark.
heroAltText: Custom gray on ear headphones with padded headband and ear cups, featuring a company logo printed on the side.
